chapter: Rhythm Club, studio dates and the 1930s big bands
title: Louis Armstrong's "Sit Down, You're Rockin' the Boat" date
summary: McRae helped engineer an Armstrong date where the Sy Oliver arrangements had not been delivered, and they discuss Armstrong's schooling.

When I got there, he said -- Oliver So Sy Alter had did the arrangements but he hadn't sent Louie the music. Louie was really mad about it.

Because Louie Armstrong was a musician that came out of Jenkins Home. Everybody thought Louie was just a high note from (inaudible), but Louie was a great musician. Louie - (inaudible) all those fellows that came out of that home down there -- Louisiana.
